title: About Me
text: I’m a Final-year International Business (French) student at DCU, specializing in Data Analytics. As the Business Faculty Representative in DCUSU, I proudly represent over 5,000 students, advocating for positive change and innovation. Beyond academics, I thrive in the world of startups, business strategy, AI, ethics, sustainability, and entrepreneurship—always driven by curiosity and a passion for impact.

🌟 What drives me?
I’m a firm believer in big ideas, bold thinking, and the power of innovation. Whether it’s solving real-world business challenges, exploring the intersection of AI and ethics, or reimagining sustainable solutions, I am constantly learning, creating, and pushing boundaries.

🎨 What you’ll find here
This website is more than just a portfolio—it’s a living, breathing collection of my journey. Expect to find:

My professional work – Projects, achievements, and insights into my career.

My blog – A space where I share my thoughts on books, business, AI, and innovation. From my artwork to travel experiences, discoveries, and lessons learned along the way.

title: About Me
text:
🚀 Where I’m headed
My dream is to pioneer meaningful change at the intersection of business strategy, AI, and ethics. In the future, I aspire to pursue a master’s degree, a PhD in Sustainable AI and Ethics, and ultimately become a university professor—inspiring the next generation of leaders.
✨ I’m here to learn, grow, and make a difference—one idea, one challenge, and one adventure at a time.
Welcome to my world. Let’s connect and create something amazing together!
